A stream flows out of a lake and down the side of a hill.
What best describes the change in energy stores?
kinetic energy → chemical energy + internal energy
A
gravitational potential energy → kinetic energy + internal energy
B
gravitational potential energy + kinetic energy → internal energy
C
kinetic energy → internal energy + gravitational potential energy
D

options.label: A
options.text: kinetic energy → chemical energy + internal energy

options.label: B
options.text: gravitational potential energy → kinetic energy + internal energy

options.label: C
options.text: gravitational potential energy + kinetic energy → internal energy

options.label: D
options.text: kinetic energy → internal energy + gravitational potential energy
